```python
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

# Define Modern Minimalist theme colors
MODERN_MINIMALIST = {
    'primary': RGBColor(45, 55, 72),    # #2D3748
    'secondary': RGBColor(74, 85, 104), # #4A5568
    'accent': RGBColor(229, 62, 62),    # #E53E3E
    'background': RGBColor(255, 255, 255), # #FFFFFF
    'text': RGBColor(45, 55, 72),       # #2D3748
}

# Load the presentation
prs = Presentation('/workspace/quarterly_sales.pptx')

# Save as a new styled version
styled_presentation = prs.copy()

def apply_theme_colors(shape, color_scheme):
    """Apply theme colors to shapes"""
    if hasattr(shape, 'fill') and shape.fill.type:
        if shape.fill.type.name == 'SOLID':
            shape.fill.solid().fgColor.rgb = color_scheme['primary']
            shape.fill.solid().bgColor.rgb = color_scheme['background']
        elif shape.fill.type.name == 'PATTERNED':
            shape.fill.patterned().fgColor.rgb = color_scheme['primary']
            shape.fill.patterned().bgColor.rgb = color_scheme['background']

def set_text_color(text_frame, color):
    """Set text color for text frames"""
    for paragraph in text_frame.paragraphs:
        for run in paragraph.runs:
            run.font.color.rgb = color
            run.font.name = 'Arial'
            run.font.bold = False
            run.font.size = Pt(18)
        # Set title paragraph
        if text_frame.text and 'MARKER_TITLE' in text_frame.text:
            paragraph = text_frame.paragraphs[0]
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                run.font.bold = True
                run.font.size = Pt(44)

print("Applying Modern Minimalist theme...")
print(f"Theme colors: Primary={MODERN_MINIMALIST['primary']}, Accent={MODERN_MINIMALIST['accent']}")

# Apply theme to all slides
for i, slide in enumerate(styled_presentation.slides):
    print(f"\nProcessing Slide {i+1}...")
    
    for shape in slide.shapes:
        if hasattr(shape, 'text'):
            text = shape.text.strip()
            
            # Title slides (MARKER_TITLE_SLIDE)
            if 'MARKER_TITLE_SLIDE' in text:
                # Set background to white
                shape.fill.solid().bgColor.rgb = MODERN_MINIMALIST['background']
                
                # Set title text
                for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
                    for run in paragraph.runs:
                        run.font.name = 'Arial'
                        run.font.bold = True
                        run.font.color.rgb = MODERN_MINIMALIST['text']
                        run.font.size = Pt(44)
                
                # Create a colored accent rectangle
                left = Inches(0.5)
                top = Inches(1.5)
                width = Inches(1.5)
                height = Inches(0.5)
                accent_rect = slide.shapes.add_shape(
                    MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height
                )
                accent_rect.fill.solid().fgColor.rgb = MODERN_MINIMALIST['accent']
                accent_rect.line.color.rgb = None
                
                # Set subtitle text
                for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs[1]:
                    for run in paragraph.runs:
                        run.font.name = 'Arial'
                        run.font.color.rgb = MODERN_MINIMALIST['secondary']
                        run.font.size = Pt(24)
                
                continue
            
            # Content slides (MARKER_METRICS_SLIDE, MARKER_REGIONAL_SLIDE)
            elif 'MARKER_METRICS_SLIDE' in text or 'MARKER_REGIONAL_SLIDE' in text:
                # Set background to white
                shape.fill.solid().bgColor.rgb = MODERN_MINIMALIST['background']
                
                # Set title text
                for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs[0]:
                    for run in paragraph.runs:
                        run.font.name = 'Arial'
                        run.font.bold = True
                        run.font.color.rgb = MODERN_MINIMALIST['primary']
                        run.font.size = Pt(36)
                
                # Set content text
                for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs[1:]:
                    for run in paragraph.runs:
                        run.font.name = 'Arial'
                        run.font.color.rgb = MODERN_MINIMALIST['text']
                        run.font.size = Pt(20)
                
                continue
    
    # Add a subtle gray footer with page number
    footer_shape = styled_presentation.slide_layouts[6].shapes['footer']
    footer_shape.text_frame.text = f"Q4 2024 Sales Results — Slide {i+1}"
    footer_shape.text_frame.paragraphs[0].runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    footer_shape.text_frame.paragraphs[0].runs[0].font.color.rgb = MODERN_MINIMALIST['secondary']

# Save the styled presentation
output_path = '/workspace/quarterly_sales_styled.pptx'
styled_presentation.save(output_path)
print(f"\n✅ Styled presentation saved to: {output_path}")
print("\n--- Theme Summary ---")
print("Theme: Modern Minimalist")
print("Colors: Charcoal Gray (#2D3748), Slate Gray (#4A5568), Red Accent (#E53E3E)")
print("Fonts: Arial Bold for headers, Arial for body text")
print("Style: Clean, professional, minimalist design")
```
